evals.prompt: Create a Metal Slug cabinet using references you find online. Prefer original official operator artwork, not fan art. Preserve the map and do not deploy.
evals.expected_output: A documented MVS variant, four cabinet sprites and editable layers, an online-source record and preview for human approval. Third-party scans are not represented as publisher permission.
expectations: Recipe retains source URLs and SHA-256 for every downloaded image.
Mini-marquee is classified as an original-art scan with underlying NAZCA/SNK rights and third-party-hosting caveat.
Two players have four physical MVS buttons each, distinct from three game actions.
All four views fit their canvases and editable layers recompose exactly.
No map changes or deployment are performed by the cabinet pipeline.

evals.prompt: Rebuild the approved Simpsons cabinet through the new pipeline without changing its appearance.
evals.expected_output: The existing four approved sprites remain byte-identical; source metadata and a legacy renderer adapter allow the new workflow to validate and build them.
expectations: The four generated PNGs match their recorded approved SHA-256 hashes.
The source references retain their user-supplied status rather than fabricated online provenance.
The cyan family-stack side art and yellow trim are preserved.
